evidence: task/task.toml:20-24 [environment] has build_timeout_sec = 600.0, network_mode = "public", cpus = 2, memory_mb = 4096 - byte-identical to the frozen template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/task.toml:20-24 and staged-task-contract.md:56-60. No docker_image and no allow_internet key anywhere in task.toml (contract line 78 satisfied). No literal secret under [environment]; the only credential-like value in task.toml is ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}" (line 34), a template placeholder in the frozen [verifier.env] block, not the agent environment. network_mode = "public" (line 22, and [verifier.environment] line 38) is the mandated profile per workbook Quality Checks #9 and SKILL.md Delivery profile; the Internal sheet's older 'no-network' annotation is superseded by the client-facing row text and skill, so not flagged. environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template Dockerfile (diff empty): node:22-bookworm-slim, express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 installed globally at build with NODE_PATH set, no ARG/ENV secrets. 2 CPUs / 4 GB is ample for a Node 22 + Express + better-sqlite3 app and the build (better-sqlite3 12.4.1 ships prebuilt binaries for Node 22; public network at build is allowed). Nothing secretly needs an install: server.js requires only crypto, fs, path, express, better-sqlite3 (lines 7-11); package.json deps match the pre-installed pins; solve.sh only copies files (no npm install); test.sh launches node with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules (lines 106-111, 162-167). Secret scan of environment/ and solution/ found only the documented demo password password123 (instructions/walls-and-retention.md:3, server.js:17), an expected profile credential per SKILL.md Known false positives. Runtime corroboration: local image cw-editor-agent-r3 used by the scripted golden run has docker history layers matching this Dockerfile step-for-step and Config.Env with only PATH/NODE_VERSION/YARN_VERSION/NODE_PATH (no secrets). Frozen hashes of package.json/server.js/solve.sh/seed_data.json match raw-evidence-index.json. Adversarial: a broken app cannot gain credit from this configuration (it grants nothing scorable), and a conforming app needing only the stated deps is not starved: 4 GB/2 CPU and public network leave room for an agent that also npm-installs extra packages into /app. Not a configured judge run or hosted-QC result; this row is configuration-level and fully evidenced by source plus local image inspection.
